import json, subprocess, sys, time, os
def call(socket, method, params, timeout=25):
    reqs = [
        {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"workshop","version":"0.0"}}},
        {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"},
        {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":method,"params":params},
    ]
    inp = "\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs) + "\n"
    # keep stdin open to receive responses
    proc = subprocess.Popen(["/home/igor/.local/share/huyang/bin/huyang","mcp","--profile","experimental","--socket",socket], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
    def feeder():
        try:
            proc.stdin.write(inp); proc.stdin.flush(); time.sleep(5)
            proc.stdin.close()
        except Exception as e: print("feeder err",e,file=sys.stderr)
    import threading
    t=threading.Thread(target=feeder); t.start()
    try:
        out,err=proc.communicate(timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        proc.kill(); out,err=proc.communicate()
        print("TIMEOUT",file=sys.stderr)
    t.join(timeout=2)
    return out,err
if __name__=="__main__":
    sock=sys.argv[1]; method=sys.argv[2]; params=json.loads(sys.argv[3]); outpath=sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv)>4 else None
    out,err=call(sock,method,params)
    if outpath:
        open(outpath,"w").write(out)
        print(f"wrote {len(out)} bytes to {outpath}")
        print(out[:6000])
        print("STDERR:",err[:1000],file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        print(out[:12000])
